scope: Input XML/lexical integrity only; no geometric interpretation, normalization or rendering.
children: Exactly one direct path with only d; whitespace-only character data allowed.
reject: DTD, entities (including references), comments, CDATA, processing instructions, extra namespaces/elements/attributes/text, paint/stroke/style/transform/resources/network references.
path_numbers: Full signed decimal/integer/leading-dot/exponent lexical grammar with finite Decimal parsing; proper comma/whitespace and adjacent sign/decimal handling; no leftovers.
path_rules: Starts with M/m; nonempty complete operand groups; implicit repeated groups counted; no operands after Z/z. Values are not converted into coordinates.
numeric_evaluation: Exact Decimal finiteness only; no Float/native range certification.
selection_translation: Carried as [0,960] declaration only; never applied in this lane.
